<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1200 800" width="1200" height="800" preserveAspectRatio="xMidYMid meet">

      <rect x="680" y="690" width="68" height="26" rx="3" fill="#3b3f43" stroke="#23262a" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <g>
        <circle cx="688" cy="703" r="7" fill="url(#rollerGrad)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 688 703; 380 688 703; 0 688 703" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

        <circle cx="706" cy="703" r="7" fill="url(#rollerGrad)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 706 703; 290 706 703; 0 706 703" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
        </circle>
        <circle cx="724" cy="703" r="7" fill="url(#rollerGrad)">
          <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="0 724 703; 340 724 703; 0 724 703" dur="1.7s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

      <rect x="650" y="520" width="10" height="30" fill="#3a3f44"/>
      <rect x="668" y="520" width="10" height="30" fill="#3a3f44"/>
      <line x1="405" y1="545" x2="645" y2="545" stroke="#3a3f44" stroke-width="1.5" opacity="0.6"/>

        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="15" fill="#2b2f33"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="9.5" fill="#e6e9ec"/>
        <circle cx="0" cy="0" r="3" fill="#1a1e21"/>
        <line x1="-10" y1="0" x2="10" y2="0" stroke="#4a4e52" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <line x1="0" y1="-10" x2="0" y2="10" stroke="#4a4e52" stroke-width="2.5"/>
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-10;6;-10" dur="6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </g>
    </g>

    <!-- Exhaust pipe with floating puffs -->
    <g>
      <rect x="396" y="532" width="30" height="20" rx="4" fill="#2b2f33" stroke="#1a1e21" stroke-width="1.5"/>
      <ellipse cx="401" cy="528" rx="6" ry="3" fill="#dfe3e8">

      <ellipse cx="407" cy="520" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#dfe3e8">

      </ellipse>
      <ellipse cx="412" cy="528" rx="6.5" ry="3" fill="#dfe3e8">
        <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 -16" dur="2.6s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="1.5s"/>
        <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0 0.8 0 0.15" dur="2.6s" begin="1.6s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      </ellipse>
    </g>

    <!-- Boom (arm part 1) -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 448 462 L 448 196 L 484 186 L 484 452 Z" fill="url(#bodyGrad)" stroke="#1a1e21" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-7 448 462; 8 448 462; -7 448 462" dur="4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Stick (arm part 2) -->

      <path d="M 484 186 L 604.7 326.2 L 600 330 L 488.7 182.2 Z" fill="url(#stickGrad)" stroke="#23262a" stroke-width="2"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="8 448 462; -7 448 462; 8 448 462" dur="4.4s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.5s"/>

    <!-- Bucket with toothed edge (digging cycle) -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 554 338 L 622 342 L 622 362 L 554 358 Z" fill="url(#bucketGrad)" stroke="#23262a" stroke-width="2.5"/>
      <g fill="#2b2f33">

        <rect x="594" y="336" width="8" height="11" rx="2"/>
        <rect x="604" y="340" width="6" height="8" rx="2"/>

      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="-10 598 350; 8 598 350; -10 598 350" dur="2.7s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.2s"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ================= Sloth in the cab ================= -->
  <g id="sloth">
    <ellipse cx="445" cy="578" rx="42" ry="5" fill="#1a1610" opacity="0.4"/>

    <!-- Hard hat -->
    <path d="M 452 494 L 463 505 L 455 507 Z" fill="#ffe07f" stroke="#c9c9b0"/>
    <ellipse cx="452" cy="507" rx="14" ry="3" fill="#ffe07f" stroke="#c9c9b0"/>

    <!-- Face mask -->
    <ellipse cx="445" cy="510" rx="30" ry="21" fill="#1a1612" stroke="#0b0908" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Dark eye patches -->
    <ellipse cx="430" cy="512" rx="4.5" ry="3.2" fill="#0b0908"/>

    <ellipse cx="456" cy="511" rx="3" ry="1.7" fill="#3a3329">
      <animate attributeName="ry" values="1.7 0.2 1.7" dur="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite" begin="0.35s"/>
    </ellipse>

    <!-- Small nose -->
    <circle cx="446" cy="516" r="3" fill="#221a14"/>

    <!-- Sleepy smile -->
    <path d="M 438 521 Q 445 528 452 521" fill="none" stroke="#221a14" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round"/>

    <!-- Body -->
    <ellipse cx="445" cy="545" rx="40" ry="33" fill="#3a2f24" stroke="#2b2520" stroke-width="1.5"/>

    <!-- Feet -->

    <ellipse cx="466" cy="566" rx="10" ry="4.5" fill="#3a2f24" stroke="#2b2520"/>

    <!-- High-visibility vest -->
    <path d="M 408 558 L 408 588 L 486 588 L 486 558 Z" fill="#ff9d00" stroke="#b4770b" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <g fill="#ffffff">
      <rect x="416" y="564" width="3" height="13"/>

      <rect x="452" y="562" width="3" height="15"/>
      <rect x="464" y="565" width="3" height="12"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Arm stretched toward the steering wheel, with claws -->
    <g>
      <path d="M 452 546 Q 462 508 490 490 Q 505 485 512 495 Z" fill="#b39a89"/>
      <g fill="#3a2f24">
        <ellipse cx="507" cy="492" rx="2.5" ry="3"/>
        <ellipse cx="514" cy="488" rx="2" ry="3"/>
        <ellipse cx="520" cy="494" rx="2.5" ry="3"/>
      </g>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="rotate" values="2 460 530; -3 460 530; 2 460 530" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- "Zzz" letters floating upward (sloth drifting to sleep) -->
  <g>
    <text x="428" y="507" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="22" fill="#d9d9d9" opacity="0">
      Z
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0 0.8 0 0.85" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 -16" dur="5s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </text>
    <text x="438" y="504" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="20" fill="#d9d9d9" opacity="0">
      Z
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0 0.75 0 0.85" dur="5s" begin="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
      <animateTransform attributeName="transform" type="translate" values="0 -14" dur="5s" begin="1.4s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    </text>
    <text x="449" y="499" font-family="Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif" font-size="24" fill="#d9d9d9" opacity="0">
      Z
      <animate attributeName="opacity" values="0 0.7 0 0.85" dur="5s" begin="2.8s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>

    </text>
  </g>
</svg>
